newsitem.title: USA: Gateway backs full-year revenue forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Gateway backs full-year revenue forecasts.

text.p: Gateway 2000 Inc, a direct marketer of personal computers, told analysts Tuesday it expected to make up a second-quarter shortfall in revenue later this year, a spokesman for the company said.
"We said we expect to recover any shortfall by the end of the year so expectations for the year as whole still look reasonable," a Gateway 2000 spokesman said after a conference call with analysts.

Earlier Tuesday, Gateway said it expected revenues for the second quarter to show little change from the first quarter, when it generated revenues of $1.42 billion. That is less than analysts had forecast, the company said.
The consensus estimate calls for earnings of $4.10 a share for 1997, the spokesman said. The company reported earnings of $3.21 a share for 1996.
